title: Mtatsminda view point over Tbilisi
description: Mtatsminda ("Holy Mountain") is the highest point in Tbilisi so it’s naturally a great place for panoramic views. The large terrace in front of Restaurant Funicular is a giant balcony over the city and the ideal place for photos.
